imts_uae.name: IMF International Trade in Goods by partner (IMTS)
imts_uae.note: UAE customs data as sent to the IMF. Exports FOB and include re-exports; imports CIF.

comtrade_uae.name: UN Comtrade, UAE-reported
comtrade_uae.note: UAE customs data as filed with the UN. Totals across all commodities (HS). The UAE had not filed 2024 with the UN at the time of the build, so 2023 is used.

comtrade_mirror.name: UN Comtrade, partner-reported
comtrade_mirror.note: What each partner's customs reports of its trade with the UAE; imports are CIF, exports FOB. Covers only the partners that file, and the UAE often appears as a transit or origin country differently.

imts_mirror.name: IMF IMTS, partner-reported
imts_mirror.note: Each partner's own report of its exports to and imports from the UAE, as the IMF holds it.

eurostat_trade.name: Eurostat extra-EU trade by partner
eurostat_trade.note: EU27 customs data (Comext). Bloc total only, so it is compared with the sum of the UAE's 27 member rows.

unctad_trade.name: UNCTADstat merchandise trade, total
unctad_trade.note: Total merchandise trade of the UAE, with UNCTAD's own estimates where the UAE has not filed. World total only.

imf_bop.name: IMF Balance of Payments, goods
imf_bop.note: Goods credits and debits on a balance-of-payments basis: change of ownership, FOB both ways, so re-exports and some goods in transit are treated differently from customs data. The World Bank's WDI (BX.GSR.MRCH.CD, BM.GSR.MRCH.CD) republishes the same figures.

ons_trade.name: UK ONS trade in goods by country
ons_trade.note: UK customs data, twelve months summed and converted from sterling at the ECB annual average.

imf_dip.name: IMF Direct Investment Positions (formerly CDIS)
imf_dip.note: Positions the partner countries report with the UAE as counterpart, so coverage and year differ by country and a partner that does not report shows as zero or absent.

oecd_fdi.name: OECD FDI positions by counterpart area
oecd_fdi.note: The 38 OECD members' own direct-investment positions with the UAE (BMD4), US$ millions, immediate counterpart.

eurostat_fdi.name: Eurostat FDI positions, immediate counterpart
eurostat_fdi.note: Euro figures converted at the ECB year-end rate. Immediate counterpart: the first country the money came from.

unctad_fdi.name: UNCTADstat FDI stock and flows
unctad_fdi.note: UNCTAD's own series for the UAE's total FDI, built from the UAE's central bank and its estimates. World total only.

imf_bop_fdi.name: IMF Balance of Payments, direct investment
imf_bop_fdi.note: Net acquisition of direct-investment assets (outward) and net incurrence of liabilities (inward) in the year: a flow, not a position. The UAE does not report an international investment position (IIP) series to the IMF.

abs_trade.name: ABS international merchandise trade by country
abs_trade.note: Australian customs data, twelve months summed and converted from Australian dollars at the ECB annual average.

wdi_trade.name: World Bank WDI, merchandise exports and imports (BoP)
wdi_trade.note: A republication of the IMF balance of payments (BX.GSR.MRCH.CD, BM.GSR.MRCH.CD): it shows that the IMF figure is carried unchanged into the World Bank's database, not a second measurement.

wdi_fdi.name: World Bank WDI, FDI net inflows and outflows (BoP)
wdi_fdi.note: A republication of the IMF balance of payments (BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD inflows, BM.KLT.DINV.CD.WD outflows): a flow in the year, not a position.

ssb_trade.name: Statistics Norway external trade in goods by country
ssb_trade.note: Norwegian customs data, the full-year value converted from kroner at the ECB annual average.

statcan_fdi.name: Statistics Canada international investment position by country
statcan_fdi.note: Book value in Canadian dollars, converted at the ECB year-end rate.

unavailable.name: UAE Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (FCSC)
unavailable.reason: its site returns HTTP 403 to scripted requests, so its foreign-trade and FDI tables are not read here

unavailable.name: UAE national open-data portal (Bayanat)
unavailable.reason: no machine-readable bilateral trade or investment dataset found at the time of the build

unavailable.name: US Census Bureau international trade API
unavailable.reason: requires a registered API key, which is not configured

unavailable.name: US Bureau of Economic Analysis direct investment by country
unavailable.reason: requires a registered API key, which is not configured

unavailable.name: IMF International Investment Position (UAE)
unavailable.reason: the IMF holds no IIP series for the UAE (the UAE does not report one)

unavailable.name: World Bank WITS
unavailable.reason: republishes UN Comtrade, so it would repeat a source already counted rather than add one
